claim: The server is a Go codebase for the backend services
Built with make and started with opencloud init followed by opencloud server; produces a single binary
Authenticates via OpenID Connect with an external IdP such as Keycloak or the embedded LibreGraph Connect
The backend does not use a database; data is stored in the filesystem, default root under $HOME/.opencloud
The README is a contributor-oriented backend readme pointing to docs.opencloud.eu for setup
